data.name: David
data.gender_notes: David is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew dod, 'beloved' or 'uncle'. Its root is Hebrew d-w-d. King David of Israel (1 Samuel 16). David is a Hebrew name meaning “Beloved”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: David expresses “Beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of David total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

data.cultural_impact: David is used in Hebrew naming tradition with the meaning “Beloved”.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for David?
What is the lucky number for David?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for David is 4 (ruling planet Rahu). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with David?
faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for David. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with David?
faq.a: Hessonite is the traditional association for David. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with David?
faq.a: Grey, Blue are the traditional associations for David. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of David?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of David total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for David?
faq.a: The meaning of David carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does David have a religious meaning?
faq.a: David is recorded as a christian name meaning “Beloved”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of David?
faq.a: In English, David is rendered as “Beloved”.

faq.q: Is David suitable for a baby?
faq.a: David is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.

faq.q: What is the full form of David?
faq.a: David is the full recorded form; any short forms are listed in the nicknames field.

faq.q: Which culture uses the name David?
faq.a: David is used in Hebrew naming traditions.
